checks.notes: preload/preload.ts(352,26): error TS2322: Type 'IpcRenderer' is not assignable to type 'void'. The onQuotaUpdate unsubscribe function uses an expression body `(): void => ipcRenderer.off(...)` — ipcRenderer.off() returns IpcRenderer, not void. Fix: use block body `(): void => { ipcRenderer.off(...) }` instead.
